feed.title: Shuai Wang Tri Lab
feed.subtitle: Academic Leader Dr. Wang Shuai, brings together key members including Li Jing, Bai Jie, Qu Weikun, and Qu Hui. The research focuses on systematically elucidating the molecular and cellular mechanisms underlying disease pathogenesis and progression.

entry.title: New project investigates nano-hydrogen therapy for dry eye disease

link.title: New project investigates nano-hydrogen therapy for dry eye disease

entry.content: A research project led by Dr. Shuai Wang at the Second Affiliated Hospital of Dalian Medical University has been included in the 2025 Dalian Life and Health Guidance Program, with RMB 600,000 in project funding. Titled “Nano-Hydrogen Therapy” for Dry Eye Disease: Mechanistic and Translational Research Through Modulation of Ocular-Surface Mitochondrial Dysfunction (Project No. 2025ZDJH01PT092), the study will run from January 1, 2026, through December 31, 2027. It will investigate how nano-hydrogen therapy may modulate mitochondrial dysfunction at the ocular surface and assess its mechanistic and translational potential for dry eye disease. The project builds on emerging evidence linking mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative stress, and inflammation to dry eye pathology; however, the clinical efficacy and optimal delivery of molecular hydrogen remain to be established. Learn more about Dr. Wang’s clinical and research program.

entry.title: New study identifies inflammatory proteins linked to primary open-angle glaucoma

link.title: New study identifies inflammatory proteins linked to primary open-angle glaucoma

entry.content: Our collaborative study, Causal association between 91 circulating inflammatory proteins and primary open-angle glaucoma: a bidirectional Mendelian randomization study, has been published in Cytokine. The study highlights FGF-19, IL-18, IL-18R1, and LIF as potential therapeutic targets and provides new insights into the prevention and management of primary open-angle glaucoma. Read the paper.

entry.title: Collaborative retinal imaging study published in IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement

link.title: Collaborative retinal imaging study published in IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement

entry.content: We contributed to a multidisciplinary study that developed a high-speed swept-source OCT/OCTA/ORG platform for structural and functional imaging of the living mouse retina. The integrated system enables rapid, high-resolution visualization of retinal structure, vasculature, and light-evoked responses. Read the paper.

entry.title: Systematic review evaluates secondary glaucoma after congenital cataract surgery

link.title: Systematic review evaluates secondary glaucoma after congenital cataract surgery

entry.content: Our systematic review and meta-analysis has been published in the American Journal of Ophthalmology. Based on 36 studies involving 3,151 children and 4,717 eyes, the analysis estimated an overall incidence of 6.6% for secondary glaucoma following congenital cataract surgery. Read the paper.

entry.title: New research explores a protective pathway in hypertensive retinopathy

link.title: New research explores a protective pathway in hypertensive retinopathy

entry.content: Our study in the Journal of Translational Medicine reports that fucoidan may alleviate angiotensin II-induced hypertensive retinopathy by modulating the SIRT1/NLRP3 pathway. The findings support further investigation of inflammation-targeted strategies for hypertensive retinal injury. Read the paper.

entry.title: Corneal transplantation brings new hope to a four-year-old patient

link.title: Corneal transplantation brings new hope to a four-year-old patient

entry.content: Dr. Shuai Wang and the ophthalmology team at the Second Affiliated Hospital of Dalian Medical University successfully performed corneal transplantation for a four-year-old child with a corneal limbal dermoid. According to the hospital report, the child’s visual acuity improved from 0.1 before surgery to 0.4 on the first postoperative day. Read the hospital story.
